patterns.note: Full-width content sections with distinct, often dark, background colors create clear visual breaks and structure the page.
A highly stylized, custom-designed logotype for 'THE MERGE' serves as both the primary brand identifier and a dynamic sticky header.
A deep, dark primary background (#292440) is consistently contrasted with a vibrant, multi-color accent palette used in custom illustrations and key interactive elements.
The large hero logotype scales down and repositions to the top-left as a persistent, sticky header as the user scrolls down the page.
Key content sections are introduced and visually branded with large, custom illustrations that integrate the site's vibrant accent colors and playful aesthetic.

technique_notes: The main logotype in the hero section uses CSS keyframes to smoothly scale down and transition its position to a fixed header element upon scroll, maintaining its presence throughout the page.
The hero illustration employs a subtle parallax effect, moving at a slightly different speed than the foreground content to add depth as the user scrolls.
Sections are full-bleed with distinct background colors, often dark, to create clear visual separation and structure, with white text for high contrast.

design_tokens.type_scale: The hero logotype is exceptionally large, complemented by bold, clear sans-serif headings and readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle corner radius on interactive elements like buttons, input fields, and speaker cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density, with an airy hero section transitioning to more compact grids for speakers and partners.

standout: The most distinctive element is the custom-designed 'THE MERGE' logotype, which not only serves as a prominent hero element but also dynamically scales and repositions to become a sticky, persistent header. This clever use of branding as a functional UI element is unique and memorable.
